_comment: Overrides for the MCP tools. Each tool's description lives with the tool in mcp-min/, and this file records only departures from it: set "enabled": false to hide a tool, or "description" to replace the text clients are shown. Run `pos-cli mcp-config` to list the tool names and see what a config does. Point MCP_TOOLS_CONFIG at your own copy rather than editing this one, which an upgrade replaces.
